meta.title: 브루큐브
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (브루큐브, a home coffee roaster (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A machine on a dark stage: night #0E1116, a graphite casing #2C3139 with an orange trim #F28C28 (the brand, and every label pin), silver metal #A9B2BC, the heater glowing #FF7A1A, beans from green #8DA35A to roasted #5A3A22. Text is off-white #F3F1EC.
rationale.type: Gothic A1 Black for the name and lines, set large on the left of the stage; label pins in Gothic A1 ExtraBold on dark tags with an orange rim; the display in a monospaced face.
rationale.motion: A product cutaway: a slow turntable orbit under one spotlight, then the front and right panels slide off and the inside works (the drum turns, the fan spins, the arm sweeps, the heater breathes); pins land on the beat; the camera flies into the drum and round to the tray; the casing slides shut at the end.
rationale.sound: Corporate at 112 BPM in A minor (7 bars in 15 s, 14 in 30 s), strings and piano with a firm kick; digital SFX for the mechanism: a whoosh for the panels, blips for the pins.
rationale.visuals: All code: a small flat-shaded 3D renderer (tiny3d) on Canvas2D builds the roaster from boxes and cylinders; beans, steam, the glow, the gauge, the pins and the display are 2D on top.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the labels carry the explanation.
